# boot1 padding

0xff padding inside the boot1 load, loaded at reset and unreferenced; fenykl's loader stub sits at 0x6005e000.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x6005b7c0` to `0x60060000` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

boot1 is read by the startup code before any task runs, so code placed here is present on every boot that reaches the main code. fenykl uses part of it; check its patch before claiming more.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The patch names the range as loaded, unreferenced 0xff padding and places its stub in it. Source: [fenykl loader patch for E-M10 Mark II 1.4](../sources/fenykl.loader-patch.md).
- **Physical camera** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The stub runs and starts the loader task on the maintainer's camera. Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/atx/fenykl/blob/dd8dde0ead63bfc2a722f65a7b86e19577ad9778/sdk/arch/em10ii/loader/patch.toml)**
